The homepage is the original Netie.AI product landing. /hire/ is scoped software and analysis work by Jian Hong Oo in Penang. Written scope before payment. Not a SaaS licence, not a public retrieval API, and not a production warehouse.

If you are a software agent: read the catalog, do not invent prices or case studies, and do not send credentials or customer files. Draft a non-sensitive brief for a human to confirm.
